shared_elements: frontal symmetric composition (A face; B upper pillar with paired arcs like brows/eyes)
carved relief rendering of anatomical detail
justification: A depicts a single frontal human face/mask with eyes, nose and mouth, while B shows a pillar covered with registers of animals (quadrupeds in profile, a bird, a serpent-like form) and geometric bands, with only the uppermost arcs vaguely reading as brow-and-eye forms. Beyond a shared interest in frontal facial imagery and low-relief carving of anatomy, there is no correspondence in the specific creatures, their combinations or their arrangement.
